1: Contrast-enhanced CT of the abdomen demonstrated a well-defined, homogeneous, oval mass arising from the posterior gastric wall, measuring approximately 10×6×11 cm, compressing the second portion of the duodenum; the lesion had fat-tissue attenuation with central contrast enhancement and trabecular architecture but did not invade the peripheral layers.
